scalars.scalar_value: Graduation from high school or evidence of equivalent educational proficiency AND three years of experience providing support services to people with disabilities.

items.item_text: 01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to be qualified. The application will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Your responses to the supplemental questions below may also be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification in a training and experience (T&E) evaluation. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response to any question. Questions that are answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Ventura County Community College District (VCCCD). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Associate Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree | None of the above

03. How many years of experience do you possess providing support services to individuals with disabilities? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

04. Describe your experience providing support services to individuals with disabilities. Please include in your response: a. The organization(s) in which you gained this experience b. The population(s) you served c. Your role or responsibilities in serving those populations d. Your specific responsibilities and the types of support services you provided e. The software and equipment you have used in delivering these services If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

05. In which type of organization or service environment did you gain your customer service or direct service experience? (Select all that apply): Options: No experience | Private sector organization | Government or other public-service organization | Educational institution | Social-service or human-service organization

06. Describe your experience providing exceptional customer service in an educational, public service, social service, or similar environment. Please include in your response: a. The organization(s) or setting(s) in which you gained this experience b. The types of information, assistance, or services you provided c. Examples of customer service issues you have resolved If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

07. How many years of experience do you possess interpreting, applying, or supporting compliance with laws, regulations, policies, or procedures related to disability services, accessibility, or a closely related area? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

08. Describe your experience working with laws, regulations, policies, or procedures related to disability services or accessibility. Please include in your response: a. The organization(s) or setting(s) in which you gained this experience b. The laws, regulations, policies, or procedures with which you worked c. Your responsibilities in applying or supporting compliance with them. If you have no such experience, please mark N/A.

09. How many years of experience do you possess using, demonstrating, supporting, or providing instruction on specialized software, assistive technology, or equipment used to support individuals with disabilities? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | At least 1 year but less than 2 years | At least 2 years but less than 3 years | At least 3 years but less than 4 years | At least 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

10. Please select all disability support and program support duties you have experience performing as part of your job duties. (Select all that apply): Options: Providing information regarding disability-related services, resources, or accommodations | Assisting individuals with accessing disability-related services or resources | Researching or recommending assistive technology, equipment, or accessibility-related resources | Providing registration, intake, or similar individualized assistance | Preparing or converting correspondence, documents, or other information into accessible formats | Maintaining confidential student, client, or program records | Compiling data and preparing required program or governmental reports | Training, scheduling, assigning work to, or providing work direction to staff, volunteers, or other support personnel | Monitoring budgets, expenditures, requisitions, or invoices | Participating in outreach activities related to disability services or access | None of the above

11. Candidates who are successful in this examination process may be contacted for future employment opportunities (within this classification) that may be at a different site than where the current vacancy is located. Which locations within VCCCD are you willing to work? (Check all that apply.) You will only be considered for vacancies at locations at which you indicate you are willing to work in response to this question. Options: District Administrative Center (Located in Camarillo) | Moorpark College | Oxnard College | Ventura College

12. Please indicate the type of job (fulltime and/or part-time) AND the type of work (regular and/or temporary) that you are willing to accept. (Check all that apply). You will only be considered for vacancies with the type of job AND work that you are willing to accept. Options: Full-time Job | Part-time Job | Regular/Permanent Work | Temporary Work

13. The testing process will require access to a computer with a camera, microphone, speakers, and a reliable connection to the internet. If you do not have access to one or more of these components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations, please indicate so below. Options: I do NOT have access to one or more of the required components and would like to request alternate testing accommodations. | I have access to ALL of the required components and do not need alternate testing accommodations.
Graduation from high school or evidence of equivalent educational proficiency AND three years of experience providing support services to people with disabilities.

Assist in the coordination and implementation of services for students with disabilities. E Provide information, training, and assistance regarding resources, equipment, supplies, and services available to students with various disabilities. E Instruct students in the proper operation of specialized software and equipment; check out appropriate equipment, aids, and supplies to students; monitor return of equipment, and maintain appropriate inventory. E Research and recommend equipment to be purchased that meets the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) requirements; determine and maintain appropriate inventory of equipment. E Provide specialized registration assistance for students with disabilities. E Recruit, train, schedule, and provide work direction to student workers; recruit and schedule readers, scribes, note takers, proctors, and tutors. E Maintain student records according to established procedures. E Prepare and disseminate correspondence and other information in an accessible format. E Compile, organize, and summarize data for various reports; maintain and update databases, reports, and records; develop or prepare required program and governmental agency forms and reports. E Research and provide input and support to the budget development process; record and monitor expenditures; maintain current budget information. E Perform a variety of administrative and clerical duties including monitoring and purchasing office inventory, inputting requisitions, processing invoices, updating the program website, and composing and distributing various forms, documents, and outreach materials. E Organize and participate in disability services outreach activities. Participate in a variety of District committees, task forces, special assignments, and related trainings. Work collaboratively and professionally with faculty, staff, students, and stakeholders from diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, and ethnic communities. E Demonstrate cultural humility, sensitivity, and equity-mindedness in working with individuals from diverse communities; model inclusive behaviors; and achieve equity in assignment-related outcomes. E Perform other duties as assigned. E = Essential duties.
